newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand optimistic about Philippines rice sale.
newsitem.headline: Thailand optimistic about Philippines rice sale.

text.p: Thailand is optimistic the Philippines will buy Thai rice in 1997 as the country needed to import between 300,000-500,000 tonnes during that year, a senior Commerce Ministry official said on Thursday.
Pracha Charutrakulchai, head of the Commerce Ministry's Foreign Trade Department, told Reuters the Philippines had expressed interest in buying rice from Thailand and Vietnam.
But the amount and terms were yet to be settled, he said. Commerce Ministry sources said an official team would return from talks in Manila on Thursday.

"Despite projected better rice output for 1997, the Philippines still needs imports to meet demand. Its government told me they are interested in rice imports from Thailand and Vietnam," said Pracha, who just returned from Manila.
The Philippine output of unmilled rice in calendar 1997 is expected to reach 12 million tonnes against an estimated production of 11.52 million tonnes this year.
It imported 119,215 million tonnes of rice from Thailand in 1995, mostly 20-35 percent grade. The country has imported 160,077 tonnes of Thai rice during January-November this year.
